page.layout: One column of running text, full width. No marginal notes. Page number at the head right. Running head at the head centre.

main_text.p: biennium jam munere functis succedant, & cum iis, qui annum tantum in collegio fuerunt, Reip. consulant. Tum totum collegium tres è sui medio capit, autoritate & usu rerum cæteris præstantio-res, qui collegium regant sententiamque ejus, ubi opus est, velut oratores exponant: quos Talemannos ex ea re appella-tos dixi. Et olim quidem ante tumultus hos civiles, ita in rebus his observatum, non lege quidem, sed more inveterato, ut in senatum nisi ex familiis nobilibus aut patriciis nemo ferè legeretur, nec temerè ex iisdem, nisi qui esset aut fu-isset è Concilio jurato tanquam senatus seminario, operamque & fidem suam Reip. minoribus in muneribus, in pro-curatione ædium, ac aliarum rerum sacratarum, & similibus probassent: In Concilium autem juratum similiter ex iisdem familiis frequentes cooptarentur, quoad ejus fieri posset, aut ex reliquo ci-vium ordine honestissimo, ut quisque erat vel eruditione, vel alia aliqua præ cæteris dote conspicuus & commenda-tus; ex opificum autem aut institorum collegiis

page.notes: The running head and the final letter of "Groningæ" are uncertain; the head is marked [?]. The 2 in the page number is an old form and is read as 215. The word "senatus" may carry a circumflex in print; it is written plain here. "collegiis" is the last line of the page and is treated as text, not a catchword, because it is set as the paragraph's final line.
